title: Aromatic Crispy Ethiopian Sea Bass Shiro
description: This peppery and crispy Ethiopian dish features sea bass in a flavorful shiro form, perfect for a crowd-pleasing dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper
Add the sliced onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Let the onion mixture sit for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld
Place the sea bass fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Spoon the onion mixture over the sea bass fillets, making sure they are fully coated
Bake the sea bass in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until cooked through
While the sea bass is baking, bring the chicken broth to a boil in a saucepan
Reduce the heat to low and let the broth simmer for 5 minutes
Serve the crispy sea bass with the flavorful shiro broth spooned over the top
